name: FX-Flipper Agent
description: A shadow-first autonomous FX strategy agent for the cNGN/USDT and cNGN/USDC corridors on Celo. It evaluates paired buy and sell cycles, isolates market allocations, protects execution-cost reserves, and requires positive round-trip economics after fees and slippage. Live execution is disabled until official Textile FX integration, transaction reconciliation, and wallet safety controls are verified.
